newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: David Jones sees deal on Adelaide store.
newsitem.headline: David Jones sees deal on Adelaide store.

text.p: Upmarket retailer David Jones Ltd confirmed on Monday it was seeking to close two of its John Martin's stores in South Australia, saying it expected to reach an agreement this week on the future of one.

David Jones chief executive Peter Wilkinson said in a statement that negotiations were at an advanced stage for the signing of the John Martin's Elizabeth store lease to South Australian based retailer Harris Scarfe Ltd.
David Jones was also discussing with Westfield Ltd the lease of the John Martin's site at Kilkenny, in north-west Adelaide, with regard to vacating the store, he said.
Wilkinson said the moves were part of an ongoing review of the group's national operations.
While no contracts had yet been signed, he said agreements expected to be completed this week would see the John Martin's Elizabeth store convert to a Harris Scarfe outlet from July 1.

David Jones has three other John Martin's stores in Adelaide -- its flagship Rundle Mall store is to be closed next year, while the remaining two, at Marion and Westlakes, are to be rebadged as David Jones' outlets.
